en.v: large skillet, spatula, grater or microplane

en.t: 8 slices Texas toast or other thick-sliced white bread
8 tbsp (115 g) unsalted butter, softened
57 g finely grated Parmesan cheese
225 g grated sharp cheddar cheese

sk.t: 8 plátkov Texas toast alebo iného hrubo krájaného bieleho chleba
8 PL (115 g) nesolené maslo, zmäknuté

225 g vyzretý čedar, nastrúhaný

en.t: 1. Spread each slice of bread on both sides with butter. Arrange four slices in large skillet and cook over medium heat until turning light golden, 2 to 3 minutes.
2. Sprinkle slices with 50 g Parmesan and, using spatula, flip over.
3. Sprinkle toasted sides of bread with 100 g cheddar and cook until cheddar begins to melt and Parmesan begins to brown and crisp, 2 to 3 minutes.
4. Once cheddar is melted, turn 2 of the slices onto the other two and press together to sandwich. Transfer to cutting board and repeat with remaining ingredients.
5. Allow sandwiches to rest about 3 minutes, then cut in half and serve.

sk.t: 1. Každý krajec chleba natrieme z oboch strán maslom. Štyri krajce položíme do veľkej panvice a na strednom ohni opekáme, kým nezačnú zlatnúť, 2 až 3 minúty.
2. Krajce posypeme 50 g parmezánu a obracačkou ich obrátime.
3. Opečenú stranu chleba posypeme 100 g čedaru a opekáme, kým sa čedar nezačne topiť a parmezán nezačne hnednúť a chrumkavieť, 2 až 3 minúty.
4. Keď sa čedar roztopí, 2 krajce preklopíme na zvyšné dva a pritlačíme, aby vznikli sendviče. Preložíme na dosku a rovnako pripravíme zvyšné suroviny.
5. Sendviče necháme asi 3 minúty odpočívať, potom ich prekrojíme na polovice a podávame.

src: Serious Eats — Daniel Gritzer — "Easy Diner-Style Tuna Melt"

en.v: Large (30 cm) cast iron pan, nonstick skillet, or a griddle

sk.v: Veľká liatinová panvica (30 cm), nepriľnavá panvica, alebo platňa na pečenie (griddle)

en.v: The tuna salad can be refrigerated in an airtight container overnight

sk.v: Tuniakový šalát môžeme uchovávať v chladničke v uzatvárateľnej nádobe cez noc

c.t: Hellmann's mayonnaise gives the classic flavour, but any brand or homemade works. Panko keeps the tuna salad light; do not substitute other crumbs, but instead reduce the mayonnaise from 120 g to 90 g.

For toasting: neutral oil gives the crispest bread without flavour; clarified butter is crisp and buttery; melted butter adds flavour but crisps slightly less. You can toast with oil and brush lightly with butter.
Majonéza Hellmann's dá klasickú chuť, ale poslúži akákoľvek značka alebo domáca. Panko udrží tuniakový šalát ľahký; nenahrádzajte ho inou strúhankou, radšej znížte majonézu zo 120 g na 90 g.

Na opekanie: neutrálny olej dá najchrumkavejší chlieb bez chuti; prepustené maslo je chrumkavé a maslové; rozpustené maslo pridá chuť, ale chlieb bude o niečo menej chrumkavý. Môžete opekať na oleji a zľahka potrieť maslom.

en.t: One (142 g) canned oil- or water-packed tuna, drained well
120 g Hellmann's mayonnaise
2 tbsp (10 g) panko bread crumbs (optional)
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
Two 2.5 cm-thick slices (for open-faced) or four 1.5 cm-thick slices (for closed sandwiches) white sandwich bread
Vegetable oil, clarified butter, and/or melted butter, for brushing the bread
4 slices Cheddar or American cheese

sk.t: 1 konzerva (142 g) tuniaka v oleji alebo vo vlastnej šťave, dobre scedeného
120 g majonéza Hellmann's
2 PL (10 g) strúhanka panko (nepovinné)
hrubozrnná soľ a čerstvo mleté čierne korenie
2 plátky hrubé 2,5 cm (na otvorený sendvič) alebo 4 plátky hrubé 1,5 cm (na zatvorené sendviče) bieleho toastového chleba
rastlinný olej, prepustené maslo a/alebo roztopené maslo, na potieranie chleba
4 plátky čedaru alebo taveného syra American cheese

en.t: 1. In a small mixing bowl, combine tuna, mayonnaise, and panko (if using). Using a fork or stiff rubber spatula, stir and mash mixture vigorously until well-combined and almost no flakes of tuna remain. Season with salt and pepper.

2. For Open-Faced Sandwiches: Position oven rack about 15 cm from broiler element, and preheat broiler. Using a pastry brush, lightly but evenly brush both sides of each slice of bread with oil, clarified butter, or melted butter. In a large cast iron or nonstick skillet, or using a griddle, toast bread slices on first side over medium heat until nicely browned and crisp, about 3 minutes; using a cooking weight or spatula, gently press down on bread slices while toasting to ensure even heating and browning.

3. Flip bread and lay one slice of cheese on top of each bread slice. Mound tuna salad on top of cheese, spreading it in an even layer, then top each with remaining 2 cheese slices. Continue to cook until bottom of bread is well toasted, then transfer to a baking sheet and broil until cheese is well melted, about 1 minute. Serve.

4. For Closed Sandwiches: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Using a pastry brush, lightly but evenly brush both sides of each slice of bread with oil, clarified butter, or melted butter. In a large cast iron or nonstick skillet, or using a griddle, toast bread slices on first side over medium heat until nicely browned and crisp, about 3 minutes; using a cooking weight or spatula, gently press down on bread slices while toasting to ensure even heating and browning.

5. Flip bread and lay one slice of cheese on top of each bread slice. Mound tuna salad on top of 2 of the bread slices, spreading it in an even layer. Close sandwiches, placing top bread slices cheese side down, and continue to cook until bottom of sandwich is well toasted; press down gently on sandwich with cooking weights or a spatula to ensure even heating and browning.

6. Flip tuna melt and cook until second side is well toasted. If your cheese at this point isn't melted enough, transfer sandwiches to a baking sheet and heat in oven until cheese is well melted, about 3 minutes. Serve.

sk.t: 1. V malej mise zmiešame tuniaka, majonézu a panko (ak ho používame). Vidličkou alebo pevnou gumenou stierkou zmes energicky miešame a roztláčame, kým sa dobre nespojí a nezostanú takmer žiadne kúsky tuniaka. Osolíme a okoreníme.

2. Otvorené sendviče: rošt v rúre posunieme asi 15 cm pod gril a gril zapneme. Štetcom zľahka, ale rovnomerne potrieme oba krajce chleba z oboch strán olejom, prepusteným maslom alebo rozpusteným maslom. Vo veľkej liatinovej alebo nepriľnavej panvici či na platni opekáme krajce na strednom ohni z prvej strany, kým nie sú pekne zhnednuté a chrumkavé, asi 3 minúty; pritom ich zaťažkávacou doskou alebo obracačkou jemne pritláčame, aby sa rovnomerne prehriali a opiekli.

3. Krajce obrátime a na každý položíme plátok syra. Na syr navrstvíme tuniakový šalát, rovnomerne ho rozotrieme a prikryjeme zvyšnými 2 plátkami syra. Opekáme, kým spodok chleba nie je dobre opečený, potom sendviče preložíme na plech a grilujeme, kým sa syr dobre neroztopí, asi 1 minútu. Podávame.

4. Zatvorené sendviče: rošt v rúre posunieme do strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C). Štetcom zľahka, ale rovnomerne potrieme oba krajce chleba z oboch strán olejom, prepusteným maslom alebo rozpusteným maslom. Vo veľkej liatinovej alebo nepriľnavej panvici či na platni opekáme krajce na strednom ohni z prvej strany, kým nie sú pekne zhnednuté a chrumkavé, asi 3 minúty; pritom ich zaťažkávacou doskou alebo obracačkou jemne pritláčame, aby sa rovnomerne prehriali a opiekli.

5. Krajce obrátime a na každý položíme plátok syra. Tuniakový šalát navrstvíme na 2 krajce a rovnomerne ho rozotrieme. Sendviče zatvoríme vrchnými krajcami syrom nadol a opekáme, kým spodok nie je dobre opečený; sendviče jemne pritláčame zaťažkávacou doskou alebo obracačkou, aby sa rovnomerne prehriali a opiekli.

6. Sendviče obrátime a opekáme, kým nie je dobre opečená aj druhá strana. Ak syr ešte nie je dostatočne roztopený, preložíme sendviče na plech a zohrievame v rúre, kým sa syr dobre neroztopí, asi 3 minúty. Podávame.

en.t: 1. Place bread slices on cutting board. Use pastry brush to brush oil evenly over 1 side of each slice.

2. Flip 1 slice over (oiled side down) and sprinkle with half of cheese. Place tomato slices on top and sprinkle with salt. Top with basil and remaining cheese. Place second slice of bread on top (oil on the outside).
3. Place sandwich in 25 cm nonstick skillet. Place saucepan lid on sandwich and press down firmly, then leave lid in place.
4. Heat skillet over medium heat and cook until bread is golden brown on bottom, about 4 minutes.
5. Use oven mitts to remove lid. Use spatula to flip sandwich over. Place lid back on sandwich and press down again. Cook until second side is golden brown and cheese is melted, about 2 minutes.
6. Turn off heat. Use spatula to transfer sandwich back to cutting board. Let cool for 2 minutes. Cut sandwich in half and serve warm.

sk.t: 1. Krajce chleba položíme na dosku. Štetcom rovnomerne potrieme jednu stranu každého krajca olejom.

3. Sendvič položíme do nepriľnavej panvice s priemerom 25 cm. Navrch položíme pokrievku z kastróla, pevne ju pritlačíme a necháme ju na sendviči.
4. Panvicu zohrejeme na strednom ohni a opekáme, kým nie je chlieb zospodu zlatohnedý, asi 4 minúty.
5. Chňapkami odložíme pokrievku. Obracačkou sendvič obrátime. Pokrievku vrátime na sendvič a znova pritlačíme. Opekáme, kým nie je zlatohnedá aj druhá strana a syr sa neroztopí, asi 2 minúty.
6. Sporák vypneme. Obracačkou preložíme sendvič späť na dosku. Necháme 2 minúty vychladnúť. Prekrojíme na polovice a podávame teplý.

To cook the steak in a skillet, heat a lightly greased cast-iron skillet over high heat until just smoking and cook the steak in batches, flipping every 30 seconds, until well browned and 50 °C inside, 5 to 10 minutes.
Rascu rímsku opražte na malej suchej panvici na strednom ohni za častého premiešavania, kým nezavonia. Pre trochu väčšiu pálivosť použite 2 ČL chipotle.

en.t: 1. Make the pico de gallo: Toss the tomatoes with 1 tsp (4 g) salt, transfer to a fine-mesh strainer set over a bowl, and let drain for 20 to 30 minutes; discard the liquid. Combine the tomatoes with the onion, chillies, cilantro, and lime juice, toss, and season to taste with salt. Drain off any excess liquid before using.

2. For the Carne Asada Marinade: In a 3790 ml zipper-lock bag, combine orange juice, cilantro, garlic, lime juice, olive oil, cumin, oregano, chipotle powder, and salt. Seal bag and lightly shake to thoroughly combine ingredients.
3. Open bag, add steak, then reseal the bag, pressing out excess air. Marinate in refrigerator for at least 3 and up to 8 hours, turning bag once halfway through.

4. Meanwhile, for the Beans: In a medium pot or Dutch oven, heat olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add onion and cook, stirring, until softened and just starting to brown, about 6 minutes. Stir in garlic, cumin, and bay leaves and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

5. Add beans, chicken stock, and a large pinch of salt and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to a bare simmer, cover, and cook until beans are just tender, about 2 hours 30 minutes; add water at any point to keep beans covered.

6. Remove lid and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until beans are very soft and creamy, about 45 minutes longer; top up with water as needed to keep beans just covered. Once beans are fully softened, allow liquid to reduce into a rich, creamy broth. Season with salt, if needed. Discard the bay leaves. Leave covered until ready to serve, or transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use; reheat before using.

7. For the Rice: In a medium pot or Dutch oven, heat olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add rice and cook, stirring constantly, until very lightly toasted, about 2 minutes. Stir in onion and garlic and cook, stirring, until onion is just starting to soften and lightly brown, about 4 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and cook until slightly darkened, about 1 minute.

8. Add chicken stock and bring to boil. Reduce heat to bare simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes without disturbing. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Uncover rice and gently fluff with a fork. Cover and keep warm until ready to use.

9. To Cook Carne Asada and Assemble Burritos: Remove skirt steak from marinade and blot dry. Light one chimney full of charcoal. When all the charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and arrange the coals on one side of the charcoal grate. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill, and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Alternatively, set half the burners on a gas grill to the highest heat setting, cover, and preheat for 10 minutes. Clean and oil the grilling grate.

10. Place steak directly over the hot side of the grill. If using a gas grill, cover; if using a charcoal grill, leave open. Cook, turning occasionally, until steak is well charred on outside and center registers 50 °C on an instant-read thermometer, 5 to 10 minutes total.
11. Transfer skirt steak to a cutting board and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Slice thinly against the grain into 1.5 cm-thick slices, then cross-cut the slices into 1.5 cm cubes.

12. Working 1 tortilla at a time and using a pastry brush, lightly brush tortilla all over on one side with water. In a dry nonstick pan, warm tortilla, wet side down, over medium heat until warmed on first side and excess water has cooked off. Brush top side with water, then flip tortilla, add a generous sprinkle of cheese all over, and cook until cheese begins to melt. Transfer tortilla to a clean work surface.

13. Being careful not to overfill, spread an even layer of rice on top of tortilla, leaving at least 5 cm of border on either side and at least 7.5 cm of border above and below. Spoon beans on top of rice, followed by additional cheese, then the carne asada, guacamole, pico de gallo, and sour cream. Fold the tortilla sides in over the filling. Then roll the bottom flap of tortilla up over the filling, holding the sides tight as you roll. Continue rolling until the burrito is sealed. Wrap in foil for a tighter hold. Repeat with remaining tortillas and fillings, wiping out skillet between uses. Serve right away.

sk.t: 1. Pripravíme pico de gallo: paradajky premiešame s 1 ČL (4 g) soli, preložíme do jemného sitka nad misou a necháme 20 až 30 minút odkvapkať; tekutinu vylejeme. Paradajky zmiešame s cibuľou, papričkami, koriandrovou vňaťou a limetkovou šťavou, premiešame a podľa chuti osolíme. Pred použitím zlejeme prípadnú prebytočnú tekutinu.

2. Marináda na carne asada: do uzatvárateľného vrecka s objemom 3790 ml dáme pomarančovú šťavu, koriandrovú vňať, cesnak, limetkovú šťavu, olivový olej, rímsku rascu (kmín), oregano, mleté chipotle a soľ. Vrecko uzavrieme a zľahka ním potrasieme, aby sa suroviny dôkladne premiešali.
3. Vrecko otvoríme, vložíme doň steak, znova ho uzavrieme a vytlačíme prebytočný vzduch. Marinujeme v chladničke aspoň 3 a najviac 8 hodín; v polovici vrecko raz obrátime.

4. Medzitým fazuľa: v strednom hrnci alebo liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olivový olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu a za miešania ju opekáme, kým nezmäkne a nezačne hnednúť, asi 6 minút. Vmiešame cesnak, rímsku rascu a bobkové listy a opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd.

5. Pridáme fazuľu, kurací vývar a veľkú štipku soli a na silnom ohni privedieme do varu. Oheň stlmíme, aby sa len mierne varila, prikryjeme a varíme, kým fazuľa práve nezmäkne, asi 2 hodiny 30 minút; podľa potreby kedykoľvek dolejeme vodu, aby bola fazuľa ponorená.

6. Odokryjeme a za občasného miešania varíme ďalej, kým fazuľa nie je veľmi mäkká a krémová, ešte asi 45 minút; podľa potreby dolievame vodu, aby bola fazuľa práve ponorená. Keď je fazuľa úplne mäkká, necháme tekutinu zredukovať na sýty, krémový vývar. Podľa potreby dosolíme. Bobkové listy vyberieme. Do podávania necháme prikryté, alebo preložíme do vzduchotesnej nádoby a necháme v chladničke; pred použitím zohrejeme.

7. Ryža: v strednom hrnci alebo liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olivový olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme ryžu a za stáleho miešania ju opekáme, kým nie je veľmi zľahka opražená, asi 2 minúty. Vmiešame cibuľu a cesnak a za miešania opekáme, kým cibuľa nezačne mäknúť a zľahka hnednúť, asi 4 minúty. Vmiešame paradajkový pretlak a opekáme, kým mierne nestmavne, asi 1 minútu.

8. Pridáme kurací vývar a privedieme do varu. Oheň stlmíme, aby sa len mierne varila, prikryjeme a bez miešania varíme 15 minút. Odstavíme z ohňa a necháme 10 minút prikryté postáť. Odokryjeme a ryžu jemne nakypríme vidličkou. Prikryjeme a do použitia udržiavame teplú.

9. Príprava carne asada a skladanie burrít: steak vyberieme z marinády a osušíme. Rozpálime plný komín dreveného uhlia. Keď je všetko uhlie rozžeravené a pokryté sivým popolom, vysypeme ho a rozložíme na jednu stranu roštu na uhlie. Nasadíme rošt na grilovanie, gril prikryjeme a necháme 5 minút predhriať. Prípadne na plynovom grile nastavíme polovicu horákov na najvyšší stupeň, prikryjeme a predhrievame 10 minút. Rošt očistíme a naolejujeme. (Príprava na panvici: pozri poznámku.)

10. Steak položíme priamo nad horúcu stranu grilu. Plynový gril prikryjeme, gril na drevené uhlie necháme otvorený. Grilujeme a občas obraciame, kým nie je steak zvonka dobre opečený a vpichový teplomer v strede neukáže 50 °C, spolu 5 až 10 minút.
11. Steak preložíme na dosku a necháme 5 minút odpočívať. Nakrájame ho naprieč vláknami na plátky hrubé 1,5 cm a tie potom priečne na kocky 1,5 cm.

12. Tortilly spracúvame po jednej: štetcom ich zľahka potrieme vodou z jednej strany. Na suchej nepriľnavej panvici ich na strednom ohni zohrejeme navlhčenou stranou nadol, kým sa prvá strana nezohreje a prebytočná voda sa neodparí. Vrchnú stranu potrieme vodou, tortillu obrátime, celú ju bohato posypeme syrom a zohrievame, kým sa syr nezačne topiť. Tortillu preložíme na čistú pracovnú plochu.

13. Na tortillu rozotrieme rovnomernú vrstvu ryže (neplníme ju priveľmi), po stranách necháme aspoň 5 cm a hore aj dole aspoň 7,5 cm voľného okraja. Na ryžu dáme lyžicou fazuľu, potom ďalší syr, carne asada, guacamole, pico de gallo a kyslú smotanu. Boky tortilly preložíme cez plnku. Potom spodný okraj tortilly zrolujeme cez plnku a pri rolovaní pevne pridržiavame boky. Rolujeme, kým sa burrito neuzavrie. Pre pevnejší tvar ho zabalíme do alobalu. Rovnako pripravíme zvyšné tortilly a plnku; panvicu medzi jednotlivými tortillami vytrieme. Podávame ihneď.

Leave covered until ready to serve, or transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use; reheat before using.

7. For the Rice: In a medium pot or Dutch oven, heat olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add rice and cook, stirring constantly, until very lightly toasted, about 2 minutes. Stir in onion and garlic and cook, stirring, until onion is just starting to soften and lightly brown, about 4 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and cook until slightly darkened, about 1 minute.

8. Add chicken stock and bring to boil. Reduce heat to bare simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes without disturbing. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Uncover rice and gently fluff with a fork. Cover and keep warm until ready to use.

9. To Cook Carne Asada and Assemble Burritos: Remove skirt steak from marinade and blot dry. Light one chimney full of charcoal. When all the charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and arrange the coals on one side of the charcoal grate. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill, and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Alternatively, set half the burners on a gas grill to the highest heat setting, cover, and preheat for 10 minutes. Clean and oil the grilling grate.

10. Place steak directly over the hot side of the grill. If using a gas grill, cover; if using a charcoal grill, leave open. Cook, turning occasionally, until steak is well charred on outside and center registers 50 °C on an instant-read thermometer, 5 to 10 minutes total.
11. Transfer skirt steak to a cutting board and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Slice thinly against the grain into 1.5 cm-thick slices, then cross-cut the slices into 1.5 cm cubes.

12. Working 1 tortilla at a time and using a pastry brush, lightly brush tortilla all over on one side with water. In a dry nonstick pan, warm tortilla, wet side down, over medium heat until warmed on first side and excess water has cooked off. Brush top side with water, then flip tortilla, add a generous sprinkle of cheese all over, and cook until cheese begins to melt. Transfer tortilla to a clean work surface.

13. Being careful not to overfill, spread an even layer of rice on top of tortilla, leaving at least 5 cm of border on either side and at least 7.5 cm of border above and below. Spoon beans on top of rice, followed by additional cheese, then the carne asada, guacamole, pico de gallo, and sour cream. Fold the tortilla sides in over the filling. Then roll the bottom flap of tortilla up over the filling, holding the sides tight as you roll. Continue rolling until the burrito is sealed. Wrap in foil for a tighter hold. Repeat with remaining tortillas and fillings, wiping out skillet between uses. Serve right away.

1. Pripravíme pico de gallo: paradajky premiešame s 1 ČL (4 g) soli, preložíme do jemného sitka nad misou a necháme 20 až 30 minút odkvapkať; tekutinu vylejeme. Paradajky zmiešame s cibuľou, papričkami, koriandrovou vňaťou a limetkovou šťavou, premiešame a podľa chuti osolíme. Pred použitím zlejeme prípadnú prebytočnú tekutinu.

2. Marináda na carne asada: do uzatvárateľného vrecka s objemom 3790 ml dáme pomarančovú šťavu, koriandrovú vňať, cesnak, limetkovú šťavu, olivový olej, rímsku rascu (kmín), oregano, mleté chipotle a soľ. Vrecko uzavrieme a zľahka ním potrasieme, aby sa suroviny dôkladne premiešali.
3. Vrecko otvoríme, vložíme doň steak, znova ho uzavrieme a vytlačíme prebytočný vzduch. Marinujeme v chladničke aspoň 3 a najviac 8 hodín; v polovici vrecko raz obrátime.

4. Medzitým fazuľa: v strednom hrnci alebo liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olivový olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu a za miešania ju opekáme, kým nezmäkne a nezačne hnednúť, asi 6 minút. Vmiešame cesnak, rímsku rascu a bobkové listy a opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd.

5. Pridáme fazuľu, kurací vývar a veľkú štipku soli a na silnom ohni privedieme do varu. Oheň stlmíme, aby sa len mierne varila, prikryjeme a varíme, kým fazuľa práve nezmäkne, asi 2 hodiny 30 minút; podľa potreby kedykoľvek dolejeme vodu, aby bola fazuľa ponorená.

6. Odokryjeme a za občasného miešania varíme ďalej, kým fazuľa nie je veľmi mäkká a krémová, ešte asi 45 minút; podľa potreby dolievame vodu, aby bola fazuľa práve ponorená. Keď je fazuľa úplne mäkká, necháme tekutinu zredukovať na sýty, krémový vývar. Podľa potreby dosolíme. Bobkové listy vyberieme. Do podávania necháme prikryté, alebo preložíme do vzduchotesnej nádoby a necháme v chladničke; pred použitím zohrejeme.

7. Ryža: v strednom hrnci alebo liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olivový olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme ryžu a za stáleho miešania ju opekáme, kým nie je veľmi zľahka opražená, asi 2 minúty. Vmiešame cibuľu a cesnak a za miešania opekáme, kým cibuľa nezačne mäknúť a zľahka hnednúť, asi 4 minúty. Vmiešame paradajkový pretlak a opekáme, kým mierne nestmavne, asi 1 minútu.

8. Pridáme kurací vývar a privedieme do varu. Oheň stlmíme, aby sa len mierne varila, prikryjeme a bez miešania varíme 15 minút. Odstavíme z ohňa a necháme 10 minút prikryté postáť. Odokryjeme a ryžu jemne nakypríme vidličkou. Prikryjeme a do použitia udržiavame teplú.

9. Príprava carne asada a skladanie burrít: steak vyberieme z marinády a osušíme. Rozpálime plný komín dreveného uhlia. Keď je všetko uhlie rozžeravené a pokryté sivým popolom, vysypeme ho a rozložíme na jednu stranu roštu na uhlie. Nasadíme rošt na grilovanie, gril prikryjeme a necháme 5 minút predhriať. Prípadne na plynovom grile nastavíme polovicu horákov na najvyšší stupeň, prikryjeme a predhrievame 10 minút. Rošt očistíme a naolejujeme. (Príprava na panvici: pozri poznámku.)

10. Steak položíme priamo nad horúcu stranu grilu. Plynový gril prikryjeme, gril na drevené uhlie necháme otvorený. Grilujeme a občas obraciame, kým nie je steak zvonka dobre opečený a vpichový teplomer v strede neukáže 50 °C, spolu 5 až 10 minút.
11. Steak preložíme na dosku a necháme 5 minút odpočívať. Nakrájame ho naprieč vláknami na plátky hrubé 1,5 cm a tie potom priečne na kocky 1,5 cm.

12. Tortilly spracúvame po jednej: štetcom ich zľahka potrieme vodou z jednej strany. Na suchej nepriľnavej panvici ich na strednom ohni zohrejeme navlhčenou stranou nadol, kým sa prvá strana nezohreje a prebytočná voda sa neodparí. Vrchnú stranu potrieme vodou, tortillu obrátime, celú ju bohato posypeme syrom a zohrievame, kým sa syr nezačne topiť. Tortillu preložíme na čistú pracovnú plochu.

13. Na tortillu rozotrieme rovnomernú vrstvu ryže (neplníme ju priveľmi), po stranách necháme aspoň 5 cm a hore aj dole aspoň 7,5 cm voľného okraja. Na ryžu dáme lyžicou fazuľu, potom ďalší syr, carne asada, guacamole, pico de gallo a kyslú smotanu. Boky tortilly preložíme cez plnku. Potom spodný okraj tortilly zrolujeme cez plnku a pri rolovaní pevne pridržiavame boky. Rolujeme, kým sa burrito neuzavrie. Pre pevnejší tvar ho zabalíme do alobalu. Rovnako pripravíme zvyšné tortilly a plnku; panvicu medzi jednotlivými tortillami vytrieme. Podávame ihneď.

en.t: 1. For the Russian Dressing: In a medium bowl, stir together mayonnaise, sour cream, ketchup, relish, lemon juice, and horseradish. Season dressing with salt and pepper and set aside.

2. For the Sandwiches: Preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Lay a sheet of aluminum foil on a rimmed baking sheet and place corned beef in the center. Bring foil edges up to form walls, then add 2 tbsp (30 ml) water to corned beef. Seal package well and transfer to oven until corned beef is heated through, about 10 minutes.

3. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan or skillet, melt 1 tbsp (15 g) butter over medium heat until foaming. Add sauerkraut and cook, stirring occasionally, until any excess liquid has cooked off and sauerkraut is heated through and glossy, about 5 minutes. Keep warm.

4. In a 30 cm stainless-steel or cast iron skillet, melt 2 tbsp (30 g) butter over medium-low heat. Add 4 bread slices and cook, rotating and moving slices around pan for even browning, until golden brown on bottom side, about 4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread slices to a work surface, toasted side down. Arrange remaining 4 untoasted bread slices in a row above them.

5. Spread Russian dressing generously all over every bread slice. Mound corned beef, making sure to let any excess moisture drip off first, on the toasted bread slices. Mound sauerkraut on top of corned beef. Lay cheese slices over sauerkraut.

6. Close sandwiches. Melt remaining 2 tbsp (30 g) butter in skillet over medium-low heat and add sandwiches, untoasted (top) side down. Cover with a lid that's slightly smaller than the skillet and cook, pressing down on the sandwiches with the lid, until cheese is melted, about 2 minutes. Uncover skillet and continue cooking, rotating and moving sandwiches around skillet and pressing down on sandwiches for even browning, until golden brown and crisp on second side, about 3 minutes longer.
7. Transfer Reubens to a work surface, cut in half on the diagonal, and serve hot.

sk.t: 1. Ruský dresing: v strednej mise zmiešame majonézu, kyslú smotanu, kečup, nakladanú uhorkovú pochúťku (relish), citrónovú šťavu a chren. Dresing osolíme, okoreníme a odložíme.

2. Sendviče: rúru predhrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C). Na plech s okrajom položíme hárok alobalu a do stredu dáme nakladané hovädzie mäso (corned beef). Okraje alobalu zdvihneme, aby vznikli steny, a k mäsu pridáme 2 PL (30 ml) vody. Balíček dobre uzavrieme a dáme do rúry, kým sa mäso neprehreje, asi 10 minút.

3. Medzitým v malom kastróliku alebo panvici rozpustíme na strednom ohni 1 PL (15 g) masla, kým nezačne peniť. Pridáme kyslú kapustu a za občasného miešania ju zohrievame, kým sa prebytočná tekutina neodparí a kapusta nie je prehriata a lesklá, asi 5 minút. Udržiavame v teple.

4. V 30 cm nerezovej alebo liatinovej panvici rozpustíme na stredne nízkom ohni 2 PL (30 g) masla. Vložíme 4 krajce chleba a opekáme, kým nie sú zospodu zlatohnedé, asi 4 minúty; krajcami pritom otáčame a posúvame ich po panvici, aby sa opiekli rovnomerne. Opečené krajce preložíme na pracovnú dosku opečenou stranou nadol. Nad ne do radu poukladáme zvyšné 4 neopečené krajce.
5. Všetky krajce bohato natrieme ruským dresingom. Na opečené krajce navrstvíme mäso (najprv necháme odkvapkať prebytočnú šťavu). Na mäso navrstvíme kyslú kapustu. Na kapustu položíme plátky syra.

6. Sendviče zložíme. V panvici rozpustíme na stredne nízkom ohni zvyšné 2 PL (30 g) masla a vložíme sendviče neopečenou (vrchnou) stranou nadol. Prikryjeme pokrievkou o niečo menšou, ako je panvica, a opekáme, pričom pokrievkou sendviče pritláčame, kým sa syr neroztopí, asi 2 minúty. Odokryjeme a ďalej opekáme, sendvičmi otáčame, posúvame ich a pritláčame, aby sa rovnomerne opiekli, kým nie sú aj z druhej strany zlatohnedé a chrumkavé, ešte asi 3 minúty.
7. Sendviče preložíme na pracovnú plochu, prekrojíme uhlopriečne na polovice a podávame horúce.

en.t: 1. Using a sharp or serrated knife, trim ends of 4 pieces of milk bread so that no crust remains; discard trimmings. Cut trimmed bread lengthwise into 4 cm thick batons. Using a food processor fitted with the grater attachment, process bread into coarse flakes. Transfer fresh panko flakes to a large, shallow bowl or high-rimmed plate and set aside.

2. If Using Chicken Breasts: Slice breast in half horizontally into 2 thin cutlets. Place them, one at a time, in a heavy-duty zipper-lock bag and pound gently to 0.5 cm thickness using a meat pounder or the bottom of a heavy 20 cm skillet. Season generously with salt and pepper. For best results, let them rest in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours and up to overnight after seasoning. Proceed to step 4.

3. If Using Chicken Thighs or Pork Cutlets: Place thighs or cutlets, one at a time, in a heavy-duty zipper-lock bag and pound gently to 0.5 cm thickness using a meat pounder or the bottom of a heavy 20 cm skillet. Season generously with salt and pepper. Proceed immediately to step 4.
4. For the Cabbage: Place cabbage in a salad spinner and cover with ice water. Let cabbage sit until crisp, about 20 minutes. Drain cabbage thoroughly and spin until dry.

5. Meanwhile, in a mortar or suribachi, add sesame seeds and pound until seeds are coarsely ground, about 30 seconds. Transfer seeds to a large bowl and whisk in mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and sugar until combined. Transfer cabbage to large bowl with dressing and toss to combine; Set aside.

6. To Fry The Cutlets: Fill a wide, shallow bowl or high-rimmed plate with flour. In a small bowl, whisk eggs and water until smooth, then strain through a fine-mesh strainer into a second shallow bowl or high-rimmed plate. Place flour, egg, and reserved fresh panko next to each other, in order. Working with one thigh or cutlet at a time, dredge in flour with your first hand, shaking off excess. Transfer to egg dish, then turn thigh or cutlet with your second hand to coat both sides. Lift and allow excess egg to drain off, then transfer to fresh panko panko. With your first hand, scoop bread crumbs on top of thigh or cutlet, then gently press, turning to ensure a good layer of crumbs on both sides. Transfer thigh or cutlet to a clean plate and repeat with remaining meat. If this is done properly, your first hand should touch only dry ingredients, while your second hand should touch only wet, making the process less messy.

7. Fill a Dutch oven or wok with 5 cm of oil. Heat over high heat until oil registers 175 °C on an instant-read thermometer. Set a wire rack on a rimmed baking sheet, line it with paper towels, and set aside.

8. Using tongs or your fingers, gently lower cutlets into Dutch oven, laying them down away from you. Fry, gently rotating cutlets for even browning, and adjusting heat as necessary to maintain temperature around 150 to 165 °C, until bottom side is set, about 1 1/2 minutes. Gently flip cutlets and fry until second side is set, about 1 1/2 minutes longer. Continue cooking, basting frequently with a large spoon and flipping occasionally, until well browned on both sides, about 3 minutes longer. Transfer to prepared baking sheet to drain and season on both sides with salt. Let rest for 5 minutes.

9. To Assemble Sandwiches: In a 30 cm nonstick skillet, melt 2 tbsp (30 ml) butter over medium heat until just melted. Add 2 slices milk bread and cook, swirling bread around pan frequently, until toasted evenly on one bottom, about 3 minutes. Transfer bread, toasted side up, to cutting board. Repeat with remaining butter and remaining 2 slices of milk bread.

10. Spread thin layer of mayonnaise (if using) on toasted side of bread slices. Top 2 of the bread slices with one cutlet each and drizzle with tonkatsu sauce. Place a handful of dressed cabbage on the sauced cutlet, making sure to wring excess moisture from cabbage before placing. Top with remaining bread slices, mayo side down. If desired, trim left and right ends from the sandwich, then slice in half. Serve.

sk.t: 1. Ostrým alebo zúbkovaným nožom odrežeme zo 4 krajcov mliečneho chleba kôrku; odrezky vyhodíme. Chlieb nakrájame pozdĺžne na hranolčeky hrubé 4 cm. V kuchynskom robote so strúhacím nadstavcom ho rozdrvíme na hrubé vločky. Čerstvé panko preložíme do veľkej plytkej misy alebo hlbokého taniera a odložíme.

2. Ak používame kuracie prsia: prsia vodorovne rozrežeme na 2 tenké rezne. Po jednom ich vložíme do pevného uzatvárateľného vrecka a paličkou na mäso alebo dnom ťažkej panvice s priemerom 20 cm ich jemne vyklepeme na hrúbku 0,5 cm. Bohato osolíme a okoreníme. Najlepšie je nechať ich po okorenení v chladničke aspoň 4 hodiny, prípadne cez noc. Pokračujeme krokom 4.

3. Ak používame kuracie stehná alebo bravčové rezne: Stehná alebo rezne po jednom vložíme do pevného uzatvárateľného vrecka a paličkou na mäso alebo dnom ťažkej 20 cm panvice ich jemne vyklepeme na hrúbku 0,5 cm. Výdatne osolíme a okoreníme. Hneď pokračujeme krokom 4.
4. Kapusta: kapustu dáme do odstredivky na šalát a zalejeme ľadovou vodou. Necháme ju postáť, kým nie je chrumkavá, asi 20 minút. Dôkladne ju scedíme a odstredíme dosucha.

5. Medzitým v mažiari alebo suribači roztlčieme sezamové semienka nahrubo, asi 30 sekúnd. Preložíme ich do veľkej misy a metličkou vmiešame majonézu, horčicu, ocot, sójovú omáčku, sezamový olej a cukor. Kapustu preložíme do misy s dresingom a premiešame; odložíme.

6. Vyprážanie rezňov: do širokej plytkej misy alebo hlbokého taniera nasypeme múku. V malej mise metličkou vymiešame vajcia s vodou dohladka a precedíme ich cez jemné sitko do druhej plytkej misy alebo hlbokého taniera. Múku, vajcia a odložené čerstvé panko postavíme v tomto poradí vedľa seba. Rezne spracúvame po jednom: jednou rukou ich obalíme v múke a prebytok striasneme. Preložíme ich do vajec a druhou rukou ich obrátime, aby sa obalili z oboch strán. Zdvihneme ich, necháme prebytočné vajce odkvapkať a preložíme do panka. Prvou rukou nasypeme strúhanku na vrch rezňa, jemne pritlačíme a obrátime, aby bola obaľovacia vrstva na oboch stranách rovnomerná. Rezeň preložíme na čistý tanier a rovnako obalíme zvyšné mäso. Ak postupujeme správne, prvá ruka sa dotýka len suchých surovín a druhá len mokrých, takže je práca čistejšia.

7. Do liatinového hrnca alebo woku nalejeme olej do výšky 5 cm. Na silnom ohni ho zohrejeme, kým vpichový teplomer neukáže 175 °C. Do plechu s okrajom vložíme mriežku, vystelieme ju papierovými utierkami a odložíme.

8. Kliešťami alebo prstami opatrne spúšťame rezne do hrnca smerom od seba. Vyprážame a rezne jemne otáčame, aby rovnomerne zhnedli; plameň podľa potreby upravujeme, aby sa teplota oleja udržala okolo 150 až 165 °C, kým spodná strana nestuhne, asi 1½ minúty. Rezne opatrne obrátime a vyprážame, kým nestuhne aj druhá strana, ešte asi 1½ minúty. Vyprážame ďalej, často ich veľkou lyžicou polievame olejom a občas obraciame, kým nie sú z oboch strán dobre zhnednuté, ešte asi 3 minúty. Preložíme na pripravený plech odkvapkať a z oboch strán osolíme. Necháme 5 minút odpočívať.

9. Skladanie sendvičov: V 30 cm panvici s nepriľnavým povrchom rozpustíme na strednom ohni 2 PL (30 ml) masla, len kým sa neroztopí. Vložíme 2 krajce mliečneho chleba a opekáme, pričom nimi často krúžime po panvici, kým nie sú zospodu rovnomerne opečené, asi 3 minúty. Chlieb preložíme opečenou stranou nahor na dosku. Rovnako opečieme zvyšné 2 krajce so zvyšným maslom.

10. Opečenú stranu krajcov natrieme tenkou vrstvou majonézy (ak ju používame). Na 2 krajce položíme po jednom rezni a pokvapkáme ich omáčkou tonkatsu. Na rezeň s omáčkou dáme hrsť kapustového šalátu, z ktorého najprv vytlačíme prebytočnú tekutinu. Prikryjeme zvyšnými krajcami majonézou nadol. Podľa chuti odrežeme ľavý a pravý okraj sendviča a prekrojíme ho na polovice. Podávame.

en.t: 1. If using a whole steak, trim and cut steak crosswise with grain into roughly 7.5 cm wide sections, then set on large plate and freeze until firm but not frozen solid, about 1 hour. If using pre-sliced steak, skip to chopping instructions in Step 2.

2. Using a sharp knife, shave steak as thin as possible on a biased angle against the grain. Mound shaved meat on cutting board and chop coarse with knife, about 5 times for store-bought sliced meat or 10 times for hand-sliced.

3. Heat an empty 30 cm cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes. Add oil to skillet and heat until just smoking. Add meat and onion in an even layer and cook, without stirring, until well browned on one side, 4 to 6 minutes. Continue to cook, stirring frequently to move and pull apart the meat slices until meat and onions are browned and meat is no longer pink, 2 to 4 minutes.

4. Stir in torn provolone cheese, Parmesan cheese (if using), salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted and well combined, 1 to 2 minutes. Turn off heat. Divide mixture into 2 individual portions the length of the rolls. Shingle 2 slices of Provolone cheese over each portion. Cover and let cheese melt, about 1 minute.

5. Center rolls, cut sides down, over each portion of meat. Working with one at a time, use a large spatula to scoop under each portion of meat and flip meat into roll to create a filled sandwich. Serve immediately.

sk.t: 1. Ak používame celý steak, očistíme ho a nakrájame priečne po vláknach na časti široké asi 7,5 cm; položíme ich na veľký tanier a necháme v mrazničke stuhnúť, ale nie zmrznúť, asi 1 hodinu. Ak používame už nakrájané mäso, prejdeme rovno na sekanie v kroku 2.

3. Prázdnu liatinovú panvicu s priemerom 30 cm zohrievame 5 minút na stredne silnom až silnom ohni. Pridáme olej a zohrejeme ho, kým sa nezačne práve dymiť. en.t: 1. For the Fish: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and buttermilk. Add the catfish, and let soak for 5 minutes. While the catfish soaks, in a medium bowl or shallow baking dish, whisk together corn flour, cornmeal, and Creole seasoning. Set a wire rack inside a rimmed baking sheet. Pat fillets dry with a napkin or paper towel. Working in batches, dredge the fish in the seasoned corn flour mixture, shake off excess, and transfer to prepared wire rack. Repeat dredging process with remaining fillets. Refrigerate fish for 15 minutes.

2. In a large Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat to 190 °C. Carefully add half the fish to the oil and cook, stirring occasionally with a spider skimmer, until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Transfer cooked fish to second wire rack set inside a rimmed baking sheet and lined with paper towels. Season with salt to taste. Repeat with remaining fillets.

3. For Serving: Open rolls, and spread cut sides with mayonnaise and/or your condiments of choice. Divide the remaining ingredients evenly among the rolls, placing tomatoes and pickles (if using) against top of roll, followed by lettuce and fish. Serve immediately, and enjoy.

4. For the Rémoulade, If Making: In a small bowl, stir together mayonnaise, minced pickles, horseradish, hot sauce, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, and garlic until thoroughly combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Set aside.

sk.t: 1. Ryba: vo veľkej mise metličkou vymiešame vajcia so skysnutým mliekom. Pridáme sumčeka a necháme ho 5 minút namáčať. Medzitým v strednej mise alebo plytkej zapekacej mise zmiešame kukuričnú múku, kukuričnú krupicu a kreolské korenie. Do plechu s okrajom vložíme mriežku. Filety osušíme obrúskom alebo papierovou utierkou. Po dávkach obalíme rybu v korenenej kukuričnej zmesi, prebytok striasneme a preložíme na pripravenú mriežku. Rovnako obalíme zvyšné filety. Rybu necháme 15 minút v chladničke.

2. Vo veľkom liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olej na 190 °C. Opatrne vložíme polovicu rýb a vyprážame dozlatista, 4 až 5 minút; občas ich premiešame cedidlovou naberačkou. Hotovú rybu preložíme na druhú mriežku vloženú do plechu s okrajom a vystlanú papierovými utierkami. Podľa chuti osolíme. Rovnako vyprážime zvyšné filety.

3. Podávanie: rožky otvoríme a rozrezané strany natrieme majonézou alebo inými obľúbenými prísadami. Zvyšné suroviny rovnomerne rozdelíme do rožkov: paradajky a nakladané uhorky (ak ich používame) k vrchnej časti rožka, potom šalát a rybu. Podávame ihneď a dobrú chuť.

4. Remuláda (ak ju robíme): v malej miske dôkladne zmiešame majonézu, nadrobno nasekané nakladané uhorky, chren, štipľavú omáčku, horčicu, worcesterskú omáčku, citrónovú šťavu a cesnak. Podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme. Odložíme.

c.t: 1. For the Fish: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and buttermilk. Add the catfish, and let soak for 5 minutes. While the catfish soaks, in a medium bowl or shallow baking dish, whisk together corn flour, cornmeal, and Creole seasoning. Set a wire rack inside a rimmed baking sheet. Pat fillets dry with a napkin or paper towel. Working in batches, dredge the fish in the seasoned corn flour mixture, shake off excess, and transfer to prepared wire rack. Repeat dredging process with remaining fillets. Refrigerate fish for 15 minutes.

2. In a large Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat to 190 °C. Carefully add half the fish to the oil and cook, stirring occasionally with a spider skimmer, until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Transfer cooked fish to second wire rack set inside a rimmed baking sheet and lined with paper towels. Season with salt to taste. Repeat with remaining fillets.

3. For Serving: Open rolls, and spread cut sides with mayonnaise and/or your condiments of choice. Divide the remaining ingredients evenly among the rolls, placing tomatoes and pickles (if using) against top of roll, followed by lettuce and fish. Serve immediately, and enjoy.

4. For the Rémoulade, If Making: In a small bowl, stir together mayonnaise, minced pickles, horseradish, hot sauce, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, and garlic until thoroughly combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Set aside.

Air fryer: 200 °C, 10–12 min, turning halfway (preheat 3 min; don't crowd the basket — cook in batches)
Steps:
1. Soak and dredge the catfish as in step 1, then spray it all over with oil until no dry coating is visible.
2. Air-fry in a single layer until golden and the fish flakes easily, 10–12 minutes, turning halfway.
3. Assemble the sandwiches as in step 3.

3. Sendviče poskladáme podľa kroku 3.

cat.en: Corn flour is very finely ground whole corn (masa harina works in a pinch). Catfish is traditional, but tilapia, flounder, petrale sole, hake or cod also work.
cat.sk: Kukuričná múka je veľmi jemne pomletá celá kukurica (v núdzi poslúži masa harina). Tradičný je sumček, ale funguje aj tilapia, platesa, jazyk Petrale, merlúza alebo treska.

tip.en: Rest the corn-flour-dredged shrimp in the fridge before frying, so the light coating doesn't slough off.
tip.sk: Krevety obalené v kukuričnej múke nechajte pred vyprážaním odpočinúť v chladničke, aby z nich ľahký obal neopadal.

tip.en: Shucking oysters for po' boys is a lot of work; buy a couple dozen pre-shucked oysters if you can.
tip.sk: Otváranie ustríc na po' boy je veľa roboty; ak sa dá, kúpte pár tuctov už otvorených a vylúpnutých ustríc.

tip.en: Sear the beef before braising for a better gravy, then cook it in a low oven and let it cool overnight in its own braising liquid, so it is tender and full of flavour.
tip.sk: Hovädzie pred dusením opečte, šťava bude chutnejšia, potom ho pečte v mierne vyhriatej rúre a nechajte cez noc vychladnúť vo vlastnom výpeku, bude jemné a plné chuti.

c.t: Fresh fava beans may not be in season with the tomatoes; include them if you find them, otherwise skip them. Pod yields vary, so no exact volume is given.

The sandwich highlights peak-season tomatoes (plum, heirloom, garden), good canned or jarred tuna and eggs; under-ripe tomatoes spoil it. Ventresca (belly) tuna comes in tins and jars of 128 to 198 g; any size has enough tuna.

Sendvič stojí na paradajkách na vrchole sezóny (podlhovasté, staré odrody, záhradné), kvalitnom tuniakovi z konzervy alebo pohára a vajciach; nezrelé paradajky ho pokazia. Tuniak ventresca (bruško) sa predáva v konzervách a pohároch od 128 do 198 g; každé balenie má dosť tuniaka.

en.t: 1. Bring 2800 ml water to a boil in a large pot and prepare an ice bath. Carefully lower eggs into pot and continue to boil for 30 seconds. Cover tightly, reduce heat to low (water should maintain a bare simmer), and continue cooking for 9 minutes for jammy yolks or 11 minutes for hard-cooked yolks. Immediately transfer eggs to ice water and allow to cool for at least 15 minutes, then peel under cool running water. Quarter eggs lengthwise and set aside.

2. Meanwhile, if using fava beans, open up fava bean pods and remove individual beans. Discard pods. Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil and prepare an ice bath. Add fava beans to pot and cook until just tender, about 2 minutes. Transfer fava beans to ice bath and allow to chill for 1 minute. Carefully peel off and discard the outer skin from each bean and set aside.

3. Core and slice (340 g) of tomatoes into 0.5 cm-thick wedges; set aside. Split remaining 230 g tomatoes in half horizontally. Set a box grater into a large bowl. Rub cut faces of split tomatoes over the large holes of a box grater, using the flattened palm of your hand to move the tomatoes back and forth. The flesh should be grated off, while the skin remains intact in your hand. Discard skin and season tomato pulp with kosher salt to taste.

4. In a large mixing bowl, combine fava beans (if using), green pepper rings, artichoke heart (if using), breakfast radish (if using), olives, scallions, and basil leaves. Drizzle generously with olive oil and season with salt to taste, and toss to coat evenly (if desired, you can also mix in a light splash of red wine vinegar).

5. Split rolls in half horizontally and, using your fingers, scoop out and discard some of the tender crumb from both the top and bottom halves. Rub smashed garlic cloves all over cut sides of top and bottom halves of each roll to infuse the bread with garlic flavor. Discard any remaining garlic,. Spoon grated tomatoes all over cut sides of rolls and drizzle with olive oil (you may not need to use all the grated tomatoes).

6. Lightly season sliced tomatoes with salt, then layer the sliced tomatoes, boiled egg quarters, flaked tuna, anchovy fillets, and dressed vegetables onto the bottom halves of each roll. Drizzle generously with additional olive oil, season with pepper (if desired), then close sandwiches, wrap tightly in parchment, foil, or reusable wrappers and let stand at least 20 minutes or up to 1 hour. Serve.

sk.t: 1. Vo veľkom hrnci privedieme do varu 2800 ml vody a pripravíme misu s ľadovou vodou. Vajcia opatrne spustíme do hrnca a varíme ďalej 30 sekúnd. Tesne prikryjeme, oheň stlmíme na mierny (voda sa má len jemne pohybovať) a varíme ešte 9 minút, ak chceme krémové žĺtky, alebo 11 minút, ak chceme žĺtky natvrdo. Vajcia hneď preložíme do ľadovej vody a necháme aspoň 15 minút vychladnúť, potom ich olúpeme pod studenou tečúcou vodou. Vajcia pozdĺžne rozštvrtíme a odložíme.

2. Medzitým, ak používame bôb, otvoríme struky a vyberieme jednotlivé bôby. Struky vyhodíme. V strednom hrnci privedieme do varu osolenú vodu a pripravíme misu s ľadovou vodou. Bôb vložíme do hrnca a varíme, kým práve nezmäkne, asi 2 minúty. Preložíme ho do ľadovej vody a necháme 1 minútu chladiť. Z každého bôbu opatrne stiahneme a vyhodíme vonkajšiu šupku; odložíme.

3. Z 340 g paradajok vyrežeme jadrovník a nakrájame ich na mesiačiky hrubé 0,5 cm; odložíme. Zvyšných 230 g paradajok vodorovne prekrojíme na polovice. Do veľkej misy postavíme štvorhranné strúhadlo. Rozrezané strany paradajok strúhame na hrubej strane strúhadla a dlaňou ich posúvame sem a tam. Dužina sa nastrúha, šupka zostane celá v ruke. Šupky vyhodíme a dužinu podľa chuti osolíme hrubou soľou.

4. Vo veľkej mise zmiešame bôb (ak ho používame), krúžky zelenej papriky, artičokové srdcia (ak ich používame), podlhovasté reďkovky (ak ich používame), olivy, jarnú cibuľku a lístky bazalky. Štedro pokvapkáme olivovým olejom, podľa chuti osolíme a premiešame, aby sa všetko rovnomerne obalilo (ak chceme, môžeme primiešať aj trochu červeného vínneho octu).

5. Rožky vodorovne rozrežeme na polovice a prstami z vrchnej aj spodnej polovice vyberieme časť mäkkej striedky; vyhodíme ju. Rozrezané strany oboch polovíc každého rožka potrieme rozdrvenými strúčikmi cesnaku, aby chlieb prevzal cesnakovú arómu. Zvyšný cesnak vyhodíme. Rozrezané strany rožkov natrieme lyžicou nastrúhanými paradajkami a pokvapkáme olivovým olejom (všetky nastrúhané paradajky možno nespotrebujeme).

6. Nakrájané paradajky zľahka osolíme a na spodné polovice rožkov navrstvíme paradajky, štvrtky vajec, natrhaného tuniaka, filety ančovičiek a ochutenú zeleninu. Bohato pokvapkáme ďalším olivovým olejom, podľa chuti okoreníme, sendviče zatvoríme, pevne ich zabalíme do papiera na pečenie, alobalu alebo opakovane použiteľných obalov a necháme aspoň 20 minút a najviac 1 hodinu postáť. Podávame.

c.t: 1. Bring 2800 ml water to a boil in a large pot and prepare an ice bath. Carefully lower eggs into pot and continue to boil for 30 seconds. Cover tightly, reduce heat to low (water should maintain a bare simmer), and continue cooking for 9 minutes for jammy yolks or 11 minutes for hard-cooked yolks. Immediately transfer eggs to ice water and allow to cool for at least 15 minutes, then peel under cool running water. Quarter eggs lengthwise and set aside.

2. Meanwhile, if using fava beans, open up fava bean pods and remove individual beans. Discard pods. Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil and prepare an ice bath. Add fava beans to pot and cook until just tender, about 2 minutes. Transfer fava beans to ice bath and allow to chill for 1 minute. Carefully peel off and discard the outer skin from each bean and set aside.

3. Core and slice (340 g) of tomatoes into 0.5 cm-thick wedges; set aside. Split remaining 230 g tomatoes in half horizontally. Set a box grater into a large bowl. Rub cut faces of split tomatoes over the large holes of a box grater, using the flattened palm of your hand to move the tomatoes back and forth. The flesh should be grated off, while the skin remains intact in your hand. Discard skin and season tomato pulp with kosher salt to taste.

4. In a large mixing bowl, combine fava beans (if using), green pepper rings, artichoke heart (if using), breakfast radish (if using), olives, scallions, and basil leaves. Drizzle generously with olive oil and season with salt to taste, and toss to coat evenly (if desired, you can also mix in a light splash of apple cider vinegar).

5. Split rolls in half horizontally and, using your fingers, scoop out and discard some of the tender crumb from both the top and bottom halves. Rub smashed garlic cloves all over cut sides of top and bottom halves of each roll to infuse the bread with garlic flavor. Discard any remaining garlic,. Spoon grated tomatoes all over cut sides of rolls and drizzle with olive oil (you may not need to use all the grated tomatoes).

6. Lightly season sliced tomatoes with salt, then layer the sliced tomatoes, boiled egg quarters, flaked tuna, anchovy fillets, and dressed vegetables onto the bottom halves of each roll. Drizzle generously with additional olive oil, season with pepper (if desired), then close sandwiches, wrap tightly in parchment, foil, or reusable wrappers and let stand at least 20 minutes or up to 1 hour. Serve.

1. Vo veľkom hrnci privedieme do varu 2800 ml vody a pripravíme misu s ľadovou vodou. Vajcia opatrne spustíme do hrnca a varíme ďalej 30 sekúnd. Tesne prikryjeme, oheň stlmíme na mierny (voda sa má len jemne pohybovať) a varíme ešte 9 minút, ak chceme krémové žĺtky, alebo 11 minút, ak chceme žĺtky natvrdo. Vajcia hneď preložíme do ľadovej vody a necháme aspoň 15 minút vychladnúť, potom ich olúpeme pod studenou tečúcou vodou. Vajcia pozdĺžne rozštvrtíme a odložíme.

2. Medzitým, ak používame bôb, otvoríme struky a vyberieme jednotlivé bôby. Struky vyhodíme. V strednom hrnci privedieme do varu osolenú vodu a pripravíme misu s ľadovou vodou. Bôb vložíme do hrnca a varíme, kým práve nezmäkne, asi 2 minúty. Preložíme ho do ľadovej vody a necháme 1 minútu chladiť. Z každého bôbu opatrne stiahneme a vyhodíme vonkajšiu šupku; odložíme.

3. Z 340 g paradajok vyrežeme jadrovník a nakrájame ich na mesiačiky hrubé 0,5 cm; odložíme. Zvyšných 230 g paradajok vodorovne prekrojíme na polovice. Do veľkej misy postavíme štvorhranné strúhadlo. Rozrezané strany paradajok strúhame na hrubej strane strúhadla a dlaňou ich posúvame sem a tam. Dužina sa nastrúha, šupka zostane celá v ruke. Šupky vyhodíme a dužinu podľa chuti osolíme hrubou soľou.

4. Vo veľkej mise spojíme bôb (ak ho používame), krúžky zelenej papriky, artičokové srdce (ak ho používame), reďkovky (ak ich používame), olivy, jarnú cibuľku a lístky bazalky. Bohato pokvapkáme olivovým olejom, podľa chuti osolíme a premiešame, aby sa všetko rovnomerne obalilo (podľa chuti môžeme pridať aj kvapku jablčného octu).

5. Rožky vodorovne rozrežeme na polovice a prstami z vrchnej aj spodnej polovice vyberieme časť mäkkej striedky; vyhodíme ju. Rozrezané strany oboch polovíc každého rožka potrieme rozdrvenými strúčikmi cesnaku, aby chlieb prevzal cesnakovú arómu. Zvyšný cesnak vyhodíme. Rozrezané strany rožkov natrieme lyžicou nastrúhanými paradajkami a pokvapkáme olivovým olejom (všetky nastrúhané paradajky možno nespotrebujeme).

6. Nakrájané paradajky zľahka osolíme a na spodné polovice rožkov navrstvíme paradajky, štvrtky vajec, natrhaného tuniaka, filety ančovičiek a ochutenú zeleninu. Bohato pokvapkáme ďalším olivovým olejom, podľa chuti okoreníme, sendviče zatvoríme, pevne ich zabalíme do papiera na pečenie, alobalu alebo opakovane použiteľných obalov a necháme aspoň 20 minút a najviac 1 hodinu postáť. en.t: 1. For the Falafel: Place chickpeas in large container and cover with water by 5–7.5 cm. Soak at room temperature for at least 8 hours or up to 24 hours. Drain well.

2. For the Tahini Sauce: Whisk tahini, yogurt, and lemon juice in medium bowl until smooth. Whisk in water to thin sauce as desired. Season with salt to taste; set aside. (Sauce can be refrigerated for up to 4 days. Let come to room temperature and stir to combine before serving.)

3. Process cilantro, parsley, onion, garlic, coriander, cumin, salt, and cayenne in food processor for 5 seconds. Scrape down sides of bowl. Continue to process until mixture resembles pesto, about 5 seconds longer. Add chickpeas and pulse 6 times. Scrape down sides of bowl. Continue to pulse until chickpeas are coarsely chopped and resemble sesame seeds, about 6 more pulses. Transfer mixture to large bowl and set aside.

4. Whisk flour and 79 ml water in bowl until no lumps remain. Microwave, whisking every 10 seconds, until mixture thickens to stiff, smooth, pudding-like consistency that forms mound when dropped from end of whisk into bowl, 40 to 80 seconds. Stir baking powder into flour paste.

5. Add flour paste to chickpea mixture and, using rubber spatula, mix until fully incorporated. Divide mixture into 24 pieces and gently roll into golf ball–size spheres, transferring spheres to parchment paper–lined rimmed baking sheet once formed. (Formed falafel can be refrigerated for up to 2 hours.)

6. Heat oil in large Dutch oven over medium-high heat to 165 °C. Add half of falafel and fry, stirring occasionally, until deep brown, about 5 minutes. Adjust burner, if necessary, to maintain oil temperature of 165 °C. Using slotted spoon or wire skimmer, transfer falafel to paper towel–lined baking sheet. Return oil to 165 °C and repeat with remaining falafel. Serve immediately with tahini sauce.

sk.t: 1. Falafel: cícer dáme do veľkej nádoby a zalejeme vodou tak, aby bol ponorený 5 až 7,5 cm pod hladinou. Namáčame pri izbovej teplote aspoň 8 a najviac 24 hodín. Dobre scedíme.

2. Tahini omáčka: v strednej mise metličkou vymiešame tahini, jogurt a citrónovú šťavu dohladka. Podľa potreby vmiešame vodu, aby sme omáčku zriedili. Podľa chuti osolíme; odložíme. (Omáčku môžeme uchovať v chladničke najviac 4 dni. Pred podávaním ju necháme zohriať na izbovú teplotu a premiešame.)

3. Koriandrovú vňať, petržlenovú vňať, cibuľu, cesnak, mletý koriander, rímsku rascu (kmín), soľ a kajenské korenie mixujeme v kuchynskom robote 5 sekúnd. Zotrieme zmes zo stien nádoby. Mixujeme ďalej, kým zmes nepripomína pesto, ešte asi 5 sekúnd. Pridáme cícer a 6-krát pulzne premiešame. Zotrieme zmes zo stien nádoby. Pulzujeme ďalej, kým cícer nie je nahrubo nasekaný na veľkosť sezamových semienok, ešte asi 6-krát. Zmes preložíme do veľkej misy a odložíme.

4. V miske metličkou vymiešame múku s 79 ml vody, kým nezostanú žiadne hrudky. Zohrievame v mikrovlnnej rúre a každých 10 sekúnd premiešame metličkou, kým zmes nezhustne na tuhú, hladkú hmotu ako puding, ktorá po stečení z metličky vytvorí kôpku, 40 až 80 sekúnd. Do múčnej kaše vmiešame prášok do pečiva.

5. Múčnu kašu pridáme k cícerovej zmesi a gumenou stierkou miešame, kým sa úplne nezapracuje. Zmes rozdelíme na 24 kúskov a jemne z nich vytvarujeme guľky veľkosti golfovej loptičky; hotové guľky prekladáme na plech s okrajom vystlaný papierom na pečenie. (Vytvarované falafely môžeme nechať v chladničke najviac 2 hodiny.)

6. Vo veľkom liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olej na 165 °C. Pridáme polovicu falafelov a za občasného miešania vyprážame, kým nie sú tmavohnedé, asi 5 minút. Plameň podľa potreby upravujeme, aby sa teplota oleja udržala na 165 °C. Dierovanou alebo cedidlovou naberačkou preložíme falafely na plech vystlaný papierovými utierkami. Olej opäť zohrejeme na 165 °C a rovnako vyprážime zvyšné falafely. Podávame ihneď s tahini omáčkou.

c.t: Masarepa is precooked dried cornmeal, white or yellow (interchangeable), sold in the Latin section of supermarkets (e.g. Goya, P.A.N.). en.t: 1. For the Roast Beef and the Jus: Set roast on a wire rack set in a rimmed baking sheet or on a platter and sprinkle evenly with the 4 tsp (24 g) salt and refrigerate uncovered for at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours.

2. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 105 °C (fan 85 °C). Combine dried mushrooms with 235 ml very hot tap water and let sit until mushrooms are softened, about 5 minutes. Drain mushrooms and squeeze dry, then mince and set aside.

3. Pat roast dry with paper towels, if needed, and sprinkle with the 1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) black pepper. In a 30 cm stainless steel or cast-iron skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat until just smoking. Brown roast on all sides, 8 to 12 minutes; return to wire rack or platter.

4. Pour off all but approximately 2 tbsp (30 ml) fat from skillet (or, if necessary, add extra oil as needed to equal 2 tbsp (30 ml)). Add onions and butter and cook until onions are beginning to soften and are lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in the minced porcini mushrooms, flour, tomato paste, and thyme and cook until mixture is well combined and begins to darken, about 2 minutes.

5. Remove from heat and push the onion mixture to the center of the skillet. Set the roast, fat side up, on top of the onion mixture. Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast until an instant-read thermometer inserted in the center of the roast registers 50 °C for medium-rare, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove from the oven and transfer the roast to a carving board; let cool to room temperature, about 1 hour.

6. Meanwhile, using a potholder, set the skillet with the onion mixture over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until deep golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Slowly whisk in the broth and Worcestershire sauce, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan, bring to a simmer, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the jus is slightly thickened, about 15 minutes. Stir in any accumulated meat juices from the rested roast. Set the jus aside off heat until ready to assemble the sandwiches. (At this point, the roast beef can be wrapped and the jus transferred to an airtight container and both refrigerated separately for up to 4 days before slicing and assembling the sandwiches.)

7. For Assembling the Sandwiches: Adjust the oven rack to upper-middle position and heat the oven broiler. Remove the kitchen twine from the roast and slice the roast as thin as possible against the grain; set aside.

8. Reheat the jus over medium-high heat until just simmering, then reduce heat to low to keep warm. Using tongs and your hands, dip the cut side of the roll bottoms (just the bottoms for now) into the jus to saturate. Transfer the dipped roll bottoms, cut side up, to a baking sheet.

9. Stir the sliced beef with any accumulated juices into the warmed jus in the skillet and let sit until heated through, about 1 minute. Using tongs, divide the dipped roast beef evenly among the dipped roll bottoms. Layer 2 slices Swiss cheese over the beef on each roll. Transfer the baking sheet with the open sandwiches to the oven and broil until the cheese is just melted, about 1 minute.

10. Set baking sheet with the half-assembled sandwiches aside. Using tongs, dip the cut side of the roll tops into the jus to saturate, then close each sandwich. Pour the remaining jus into individual serving cups, about 120 ml per serving. Serve sandwiches with the jus.

3. Pečienku podľa potreby osušíme papierovými utierkami a posypeme 1½ ČL (7,5 ml) čierneho korenia. V nerezovej alebo liatinovej panvici s priemerom 30 cm zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olej, kým sa nezačne práve dymiť. 5. Remove from heat and push the onion mixture to the center of the skillet. Set the roast, fat side up, on top of the onion mixture. 6. Meanwhile, using a potholder, set the skillet with the onion mixture over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until deep golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. en.t: 1. Combine 1 tbsp (15 ml) water and ½ tsp (2.5 ml) baking soda in small bowl. In large bowl, toss 455 g 85 percent lean ground beef with baking soda mixture and ½ tsp (2.5 ml) table salt until thoroughly combined. Set aside.

2. Heat 2 tsp (10 ml) vegetable oil in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add ½ finely chopped onion and remaining ⅛ tsp (0.6 ml) baking soda and stir to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, 3 to 4 minutes. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in 2 tsp (10 ml) packed brown sugar, 2 tsp (10 ml) paprika, ¼ tsp (1.2 ml) red pepper flakes, and remaining ⅛ tsp (0.6 ml) table salt and cook, stirring constantly, until paprika is fragrant, about 1 minute. Add 59 ml tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, until paste is rust-colored, 3 to 4 minutes.

3. Add beef and cook, breaking up meat with wooden spoon, until beef is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Mash beef with potato masher until fine-textured, about 1 minute. Add 79 ml ketchup, 1 tbsp (15 ml) red wine vinegar, and 1 tbsp (15 ml) Worcestershire sauce and stir to combine, scraping up any browned bits.

4. Combine ½ tsp (2.5 ml) cornstarch and remaining 1 tbsp (15 ml) water in small bowl, then pour cornstarch mixture over beef and stir to incorporate. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens and coats beef, about 1 minute. Season with table salt, extra sugar, and extra red wine vinegar to taste. Spoon beef mixture onto 4 hamburger buns and serve.

c.t: 1. Combine 1 tbsp (15 ml) water and ½ tsp (2.5 ml) baking soda in small bowl. In large bowl, toss 455 g 85 percent lean ground beef with baking soda mixture and ½ tsp (2.5 ml) table salt until thoroughly combined. Set aside.

2. Heat 1¼ tsp (6 ml) vegetable oil in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add ½ finely chopped onion and remaining ⅛ tsp (0.6 ml) baking soda and stir to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, 3 to 4 minutes. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in 1 tsp (4 g) packed brown sugar, 2 tsp (10 ml) paprika, ¼ tsp (1.2 ml) red pepper flakes, and remaining ⅛ tsp (0.6 ml) table salt and cook, stirring constantly, until paprika is fragrant, about 1 minute. Add 59 ml tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, until paste is rust-colored, 3 to 4 minutes.

3. Add beef and cook, breaking up meat with wooden spoon, until beef is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Mash beef with potato masher until fine-textured, about 1 minute. Add 79 ml ketchup, 1 tbsp (15 ml) apple cider vinegar, and 1 tbsp (15 ml) Worcestershire sauce and stir to combine, scraping up any browned bits.

4. Combine ½ tsp (2.5 ml) cornstarch and remaining 1 tbsp (15 ml) water in small bowl, then pour cornstarch mixture over beef and stir to incorporate. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens and coats beef, about 1 minute. Season with table salt, extra sugar, and extra apple cider vinegar to taste. Spoon beef mixture onto 4 hamburger buns and serve.
